inference_unit: data block; repetitions and checkpoints aggregated within block
model_randomness_note: repetition labels do not imply shared service randomness

E0.interpretation: event count is descriptive and not an independent sample

EG.interpretation: event count is descriptive and not an independent sample

branch_selection.eligible: valid non-identical program with validation loss difference in (0, 0.035] and probe behavior distance > 0.08
branch_selection.winner: minimum validation loss, then minimum node id
branch_selection.behavior_distance: chapter6_demo.benchmarks.behavior_distance over aligned probe behavior descriptors; strict threshold > 0.08

planned.starting_reference_test_policy: After the global gate, evaluate one validation-selected starting incumbent and one eligible branch per checkpoint; unavailable branch stays missing.
planned.branch_missing_rule: retain B as unavailable; never replace or resample checkpoint
planned.test_freeze: freeze validation-selected candidates at proposals 4 and 8 for every action/repetition; open Test only after all 128 jobs terminate
planned.interpretation: Diagnostic estimation only. Stage B cannot declare H1 support, regardless of point estimates or nominal intervals; report every block, endpoint, missing result, and cost.

limitations: Stage B is a development diagnostic, not confirmation.
Test contrasts are block-level descriptive estimates and do not select a method.
Unavailable B branches remain missing in conditional analysis; fallback-to-I is separately labeled.
No test result is manufactured for sent_unknown, invalid, or absent outcomes.
